values.content:
=I have the following JSON data containing live UK energy tariffs for the North West region retrieved today from the Octopus Energy API. Analyse this data and write a 1000-word consumer report.

DATA:
{{ $json.tariff_data }}

Your report must:
- Use ONLY the exact pence figures in the data above
- Compare unit rates and standing charges across all tariffs
- Calculate estimated annual costs assuming 3,100 kWh electricity and 8,000 kWh gas
- Assess contract flexibility and exit fees
- Note which tariffs are green energy
- End with a numbered top 3 recommendation

Write the report now. Do not explain how to build a system. Just write the report.

Note: some tariffs are specialist (EV, heat pump, dynamic pricing) — flag these clearly 
and explain who they are suitable for rather than comparing them directly on unit rate alone.
